Updated - October 21, 2026 04:23 pm IST - Thiruvananthapuram
The non-monsoon timetable for trains operating via the Konkan Railway route has come into effect from Wednesday (October 21). Passengers are requested to check the train timings before commencing their journey for trains running via the Konkan route, the Southern Railway said in a statement here on Wednesday. The revised schedule is available in the RailOne Mobile App as well as the NTES Website. The railways also urged passengers not to rely on private mobile applications or websites for revised train schedules and other details.
